name: Composite Materials
summary: Explains how combining fibres, particles and matrices produces materials stiffer, stronger and lighter than their constituents.

topics.name: Classification: particle-, fibre- and structural composites; PMC, MMC and CMC
Reinforcements: glass, carbon, aramid, UHMWPE, ceramic and natural fibres
Matrices: thermoset, thermoplastic, metal and ceramic
Rule of mixtures: longitudinal and transverse stiffness (Voigt and Reuss bounds)
Short-fibre composites: critical fibre length and shear-lag theory
The fibre-matrix interface: sizing, adhesion and load transfer
Strength of unidirectional composites and failure modes
Introduction to laminates: ply orientation and quasi-isotropic lay-ups
Metal-matrix composites: SiC/Al, B/Al and their processing
Applications in aircraft, automotive, sports goods and wind turbines
